headings.text: 8 Free Resources to Learn English if You Are from India
3. YouTube: Learn English with TV Series

paragraphs: YouTube channels, apps and websites that actually help Indian learners — picked for Hindi-friendly explanations and daily practice.
You do not need to pay for English. These free resources work well for Indian learners.
Daily speaking drills with instant feedback. Practice pronunciation, shadowing and minimal pairs free, no sign-up.
Clear British accent, short lessons, subtitles. Great for grammar and pronunciation.
Uses clips from shows to teach real conversation. Fun and practical.
Read one short article daily. Note 3 new words. Builds vocabulary naturally.
10-minute episodes on slang and phrases. Listen during commute.
Good for daily habit building, though less for speaking.
Chat with native speakers who want to learn Hindi. Free exchange.
Ask it questions in English. It forces you to speak clearly.
Pick one speaking tool (SpeakNow) and one reading source. Spend 15 minutes on each daily. More tools = more confusion.
Consistency with two good resources beats dozens used once.
Free browser-based English speaking practice. No downloads, no sign-ups, no data leaving your computer.
